notes.title: 🎉 Updated TorchR Runners: Demastered Joins the Laughs & Smiles Game Festival 🎉
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268555/053b5e4d2c3b79825175cb287b65acc2badc07ff.png📅 Glorious Day: 30/01/2025!


Runners, brace yourselves! TorchR Runners: Demastered is proudly part of the Laughs & Smiles Game Festival, a digital showcase celebrating games that will make you laugh and/or smile! 😆✨ Get ready for some chaotic fun and spooky thrills!

Also, with the new game patch releasing today, Master TorcherR has bestowed upon us another set of commands to enhance your (and our) suffering—err, gaming experience. Prepare your eyes for a feast and your spirits for more chaos in TorchR Runners: Demastered!

🔍 What to Expect from Us:
✔️ Co-op Chaos – Every death hurts the whole team! 💀🤝
✔️ The TorcherR’s Taunts – Your biggest fan... or worst enemy. 😈🎤
✔️ Simple Controls, Intense Gameplay – Easy to learn, tough to master. 🎮🔥
✔️ Somewhat Time-Based Pressure – Your torch won’t last forever, so hurry up! ⏳🕯️
✔️ Retro-Inspired Visuals & Eerie Atmosphere – Looks nostalgic, plays like a nightmare. 👾🌙
✔️ Enhanced Features – Thanks to our latest patch, enjoy smoother performance and better visuals. 🚀✨

Latest Game Patch Released!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268555/6719c5704f99f32ddbf88034cb41d7dcdc32e821.png
🛠️ What's New:

 Gamepad Support: Now compatible with Xbox and Sony PlayStation controllers.
 Local Split Screen Mode: Up to 4 players can join on a single PC.
 DEhanced DEmastered Graphics: Embracing that nostalgic 90s aesthetic.
 Overall Performance Updates: Smoother and more stable gameplay.
 Adjusted Game Over Sound: Reduced volume for a less jarring experience (We did this against TorcherR’s will for your wellbeing).


💀 Try the Demo and See If You Can Handle the darkness! 💀

🔧 Further Updates:

 DEhanced Graphics: Tweaked visuals, crunched textures, and more colors.
 Bug Fixes: Squashed pesky bugs for a smoother gameplay experience.
 Feature Overhauls: Revamped mechanics for sanity, jumpscares, torch management, and darkness to heighten immersion.
 Selectable Characters: Choose from a variety of characters, so you know whom to blame.


🔮 Farther in the Future:

 Additional Levels: Introducing new stages to enhance the learning curve and keep the challenges fresh.
 Customizable Difficulty: Tailor your experience by selecting difficulty settings that adjust level complexity.
 Innovative Mechanics & Challenges: Stay tuned for new gameplay mechanics and obstacles that will test your skills.


❤ Wishlist us on Steam! 
– Every wishlist fuels the flames and helps us reach more players🔥❤

🎮 Join the Fun:
Check out the Laughs & Smiles Game Festival on Steam, play some awesome games, and let’s survive the madness together! 🤪🎉

🔗 Connect with Us:
Have questions, feedback, or just want to chat? Join our Discord and become part of the chaos - https://discord.gg/AN3DCfuGsf Master is waiting four you! 💬🎮

Long live Master TorcherR.
- The Minions
[strike](Still alive, still working…) 🛠️😴[/strike]

notes.title: Patch Notes: Demo Update 0.1 – Master TorcherR Commands It!
notes.content:
📅 Glorious Day: 26/11/2024!
Minions, rejoice! Master TorcherR has graciously allowed us to fix things (after much yelling). Behold the results of our scurrying!

⚡ Major Commands From Our Master

 "ADD MENU! Runners love options!"
 A shiny new menu has been added for graphics, sound, and even starting a new game.
 (Pro tip: Press ESC mid-game—no more excuses to slack off!)

 "LOADING SCREENS NEED QUOTES!"
 Inspirational (or terrifying) words of wisdom from our Master now grace the loading screens.
 Read them. Fear them. Love them.

 "ENDGAME SCREEN FOR LOSERS!"
 Whether you fail or succeed, a fancy new endgame screen awaits.

 “ADD EVIL MIST! Make everything scarier!”
 A sinister fog now blankets the world, creeping into every corner.
 You can’t hide. You won’t escape. But it does look cool, right?

 “MORE HORROR! MORE FEAR!”
 The game is darker, scarier, and 100% more likely to make you regret playing it.
 Don’t blame us—we just do what we’re told.


🛠️ Specific Orders We Followed (Mostly)
1️⃣ Sound Fixes & Additions

 Added countless creepy sounds for that extra "atmosphere."
 Fixed breathing sounds!
 Low sanity now means your Runner breathes like us after running from the Master.
 Buy sanity, and the creepy breathing stops.
 (Master says: “Good job. You’re alive. For now.”)
 Music now shifts depending on where you are.
 We toiled for days perfecting the vibe. Don’t waste it.

2️⃣ Bug Fixes

 Fixed the respawn curse: No more runners staying dead if they die together.
 Fixed pressure plates: They no longer scream endlessly when stepped on.
 Fixed greedy coin stashing: No more hoarding 500 coins, you sneaky minions.

3️⃣ Multiplayer Magic

 Stabilized multiplayer.
 No more sneaky runners joining sessions already in progress.
 Fixed lobbies: Lounge without randomly losing sanity or lives.
 (We suspect sabotage, but Master forgives none.)

4️⃣ Graphics & Visual Enhancements

 Added glorious visual effects to amplify the terror.
 Fixed textures and map issues where runners could get stuck or fall into the void.
 Clients now see the same effects as the host.
 (The Master insists on consistency!)


💬 Praise, Criticism, or Coin Offerings?
Direct all correspondence to: https://discord.gg/uDrJ5mpM
Master TorcherR demands your input… but only the useful kind.

Signed, The Minions
(Still alive, still working… barely.)
